newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Sept 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Sept 7.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crushing rate slipped to 1.844 million tonnes from 1.889 million in the week ended September 7, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 13 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content rose to 14.26 percent from 13.86 percent the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 20.13 million tonnes, up from 16.14 million at the same time in 1995.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended September 7 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-

NOTE: Estimated 1996 cane crop: Australia 40,129,000 tonnes. Queensland 37,891,000, New South Wales 2,238,000.

1995 Summary - Total cane crushed 37.389 million tonnes (Qld 35.295 million, NSW 2.094 million), sugar produced 4.98 million tonnes 94 n.t., (Qld 4.73 million, NSW 244,629), sugar content (CCS) 13.12 percent (Qld 13.22 percent, NSW 11.41 percent).
